ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Keylogging
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to intercept credentials as the user types them. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-Keystrokes.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ProcAddress\\ user32\\\.dll\\ GetAsyncKeyState.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ProcAddress\\ user32\\\.dll\\ GetForegroundWindow.*")))
